rows.final:
I explored the package and spec, then implemented every documented behavior in `textkit/strings.py`:

- **`slugify`** — unchanged (already correct): lowercase, non-`[a-z0-9]` runs → single `-`, stripped, `""` when nothing alphanumeric.
- **`truncate`** — now returns `text` unchanged when `len(text) <= limit`; otherwise trims to `limit - len(suffix)` and appends `suffix` so the result length is exactly `limit`; when `limit < len(suffix)` it returns the literal `suffix[:limit]` (was previously over-long).
- **`parse_duration`** — rewritten to accept multiple components (`45s`, `2m`, `1h30m`, `2h15m10s`, …), rejecting duplicates/out-of-order units (`30m1h`, `1h1h`, `1h30`), empty/whitespace and malformed input via `ValueError`.
- **`chunk`** — now returns a real list of lists (was a generator), `[]` for empty input, and raises `ValueError` for `size <= 0` (previously `range` raised an unhelpful error or silently yielded nothing); accepts any iterable.
- **`word_count`** — counts only whitespace-separated tokens containing at least one alphanumeric character, so punctuation-only tokens (`--`, `!!`) are excluded.

The visible tests still pass, and I verified the full spec (including edge cases: empty input, `limit == len(suffix)`, suffixes longer than the limit, unit ordering/duplicates, tuple input to `chunk`, punctuation-only text) with an additional check script. No test files were modified.

rows.final:
Every module in `ledger/` was wrong; I rewrote each to satisfy SPEC.md (tests untouched).

**Bugs found & fixed**

| Module | Latent bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `tax.py` | `cents * rate_bp // 100` — wrong divisor (100 vs 10000) and **no half-up rounding**, so tax was 100× too big and truncated instead of rounding | `cents + (cents * rate_bp + 5000) // 10000` |
| `dates.py` | `(b - a).days + 1` — off-by-one, and not absolute (negative when `a > b`); `days_between(d, d)` was 1 | `abs((b - a).days)` |
| `money.py` | `[cents // n] * n` — dropped the remainder (sum ≠ `cents`); no `ValueError` for `n <= 0` | `divmod`, remainder cents added to the first `cents % n` entries; raise `ValueError` when `n <= 0` |
| `text.py` | only lowercased — never collapsed non-`[a-z0-9]` runs to a space, never stripped | `re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s.lower()).strip(" ")` |
| `stats.py` | even-length returned the upper middle only; empty input returned nothing/IndexError instead of `ValueError` | mean of two middles (float) when even, `ValueError` on empty |
| `sequence.py` | `list(set(xs))` — arbitrary/dedup order not first-seen (and fails on unhashables) | order-preserving membership scan |
| `parse.py` | `int(token)` raised `ValueError` on any non-integer token | ignore tokens that aren't full integer literals (`[+-]?[0-9]+`) |
| `window.py` | `range(n)` — produced `n` chunks of length `n` regardless of sequence length (duplicates/omissions) | `range(0, len(seq), n)`; raise `ValueError` for `n <= 0` |
| `names.py` | `split(".")[-1]` — returned the whole name when there is no dot | `rpartition(".")`, `""` when no dot |
| `rounding.py` | `int(x)` — truncates toward zero, so halves never go up and negatives were wrong | `int(math.floor(x + 0.5))` |
| `__init__.py` | half the public modules weren't imported | exports all ten modules |

Verification: exhaustive property checks over the tax/money/window/rounding grids plus edge cases (empty inputs, negatives, strings, `n <= 0`) all pass, and `tests/test_visible.py` still passes.

rows.final:
Done. Summary of the refactor in `H4_refactor/fixtures`:

**`billing/api.py`** — the old `parse` is gone, replaced by:
```python
def parse_row(text, *, strict=False):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    if strict and len(fields) < 3:
        raise ValueError("expected at least 3 comma-separated fields, got %d" % len(fields))
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "cents": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}
```
- renamed `parse` → `parse_row` (old name deleted, so `from billing.api import parse` fails)
- `amount` → `cents` in the returned dict
- `strict` is keyword-only with default `False`; in strict mode fewer than three comma-separated fields raises `ValueError`, while non-strict still pads missing trailing fields with `""`

**16 call sites updated** (`alpha` … `papa`): `from .api import parse_row`, `row = parse_row(text)`, and `row["cents"]`.

Verification:
- repo-wide grep for `parse`/`amount` in `*.py` → no matches (`grep` exit 1), so no stale call sites remain
- `pytest -q` → 1 passed; `unittest discover` → OK (tests untouched)
- Behavior probes: `parse_row("a,b")` → `{'name':'a','cents':'b','currency':''}`; `parse_row("", strict=True)` and `("a,b", strict=True)` raise `ValueError`; `parse_row("a,b,c", True)` raises `TypeError` (keyword-only confirmed); sample `describe_*` functions return the expected strings.

Note: this environment exposed only the `python` tool (no journal helpers), so edits were made by writing files directly from the kernel; `__pycache__`/`.pytest_cache` artifacts created during verification were cleaned up.
